name: Soi Dog Blues

attrs.liveMusic: live music Friday and Sunday; Sunday runs happy hour 19:00, house band 20:30, blues jam open mic 21:15
attrs.liveMusicVia: the bar's own Instagram bio and Sunday event highlight, read 2026-08-31
attrs.openedNote: opened 29 August, with a Blues & Soul night
attrs.pinNote: 95/4 is in the same alley as The Hideout at 95/10 (OSM node 2655178493, 18.7936169/98.9944815), but OSM's two 95/10 records disagree by ~200 m, so no pin is copied from them — walk it
attrs.tambonNote: ตำบลยังไม่ยืนยัน — third-party listings say ช้างม่อย; Sithiwongse records in our own crawl carry ศรีภูมิ, and 95/x sits close to the boundary just east of the moat's north-east corner. Left out of the address rather than guessed

blurb_th: บาร์บลูส์เล่นสดในตรอกถนนสิทธิวงศ์ เบียร์เย็น ค็อกเทล และอาหารทานเล่น มีดนตรีสดคืนวันศุกร์และวันอาทิตย์ คืนวันอาทิตย์เปิดเวทีให้นักดนตรีขึ้นแจมกับวงประจำร้านตั้งแต่สามทุ่มกว่า ร้าน FUBAR อยู่ติดกัน
blurb_en: A live blues bar in the Sithiwongse alley — cold beer, cocktails, bar bites, and a house band on Friday and Sunday nights. Sunday opens the stage: happy hour at 19:00, house band at 20:30, blues jam and open mic at 21:15. FUBAR is next door.

sources.via: one of two expat-facing bars sharing this side street, next door to FUBAR

the bar's own account: "House of Blues (and other jazz) · Live music every Friday & Sunday · Cocktails, beer, bar bites". Sunday highlight gives 19:00 happy hour, 20:30 house band, 21:15 blues jam open mic. Third-party listings say Friday/Saturday/Sunday; the bar's own bio is taken over them
opening night, 29 August — Blues & Soul Night with Anna & Bank. CityLife gives no address or owner

the link in the bar's own Instagram bio; it resolves to "Soi Dog Blues 95/4 Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50300", which settles the house number in the bar's own words. No pin is taken from Google — the coordinates stay unset until somebody walks it. The tambon is unstated there; third-party listings say Chang Moi, and Sithiwongse records in our own crawl carry ต.ศรีภูมิ, so it is not confirmed. No phone published anywhere we looked
